name: Cheesy Basil Pesto Polenta Bake with Spinach & Mushrooms

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 220°C (425°F). Coat two baking dishes with a thin layer of oil and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add mushrooms, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 (227g ) pkgs sliced white mushrooms
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, slice polenta crosswise into ½-inch thick rounds.
Wash and dry spinach. (Skip this step if it came pre-washed.)
When the mushrooms are done, add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Add the pesto, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
Arrange polenta slices in the bottom of the baking dishes, overlapping slightly. Top with the sautéed veggies and pesto, then sprinkle with cheese.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ cups shredded cheese, Italian blend

instructions.primary_message: Place baking dishes in the oven and bake until cheese is bubbly and golden, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide polenta bake between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
